acceptance_criteria.summary: Checklist criteria in the story's Acceptance section; a checklist-like line in any other section or in a code block counts nothing.

test_scenarios.summary: Scenarios the story's Test Plan defines under its <story-id>-TS-### headings; a scenario id the plan only cites in prose counts nothing.

implementation_roles.summary: The owner role plus every supporting role, the implementation roles a Delivery Item runs before code review and QA.

contract_deltas.summary: Expected contract deltas: 1 when software_architect is among the story's roles, an expected architecture delta. An expected Operation contract revision counts once the owner adopts a story classification for it.
